description:
Pay {1} to activate Patron of the Moon, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed 
When Dimir Aqueduct enters, it triggers
Holding priority, activate Dimir Aqueduct by tapping it, adding two mana.
Resolve Dimir Aqueduct's triggered ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
